change:
Two decisions.
(1) NEW, static.yml. .github/workflows/static.yml (commit 8c91752, 2026-10-22; the draft predates it) deploys the whole repository root (`path: '.'`) to GitHub Pages on every push to claude/clever-johnson-gnso1s (the remote's default branch), through the same `github-pages` environment and the same `pages` concurrency group as this card's `pages` job. A Pages site is one deployment, so the next branch push replaces the release's index-only site: https://m516.github.io/blender-painterly-render-plugin/index.json then answers 404 for every user's remote repository until the next release (no index.json is tracked at the root), and a release deploy in turn replaces the repo-tree site. The shared group also lets a later static.yml run cancel a still-pending release `pages` job (GitHub keeps one pending job per group). static.yml pins `actions/deploy-pages@v5` and `actions/configure-pages@v5`; this card and its Step 3 test pin `deploy-pages@v4`. Options: (a) retire static.yml's `push` trigger (or the file), so release.yml's `pages` is the only publisher; the card must then list static.yml under Modify (it is in neither list) or leave the edit to the owner; (b) keep both and make every deployment carry the index (static.yml fetches the latest release's index; a redesign); (c) move the index off Pages, which changes docs/plan.md 'Distribution' and install.md. Align the action versions whatever is chosen. If (a) is not chosen, 'the deployed site equals the artifact' holds only until the next branch push.
(2) The panel's post-deploy step is flawed. Under the runner's `bash -eo pipefail`, the assignment `actual="$(curl -fsS ... | ...)"` exits the step at the first curl failure (a 404 before the first deployment propagates, that is the first release), so the loop retries only on a stale 200. Ten attempts and `sleep 60` are hand-picked (CLAUDE.md rule 2), the last check falls at about 9 minutes, and no max-age source is in the tree. Step 3's test pins no such step. Options: (i) no new step: the owner's `curl` equality check (kept by the exec#3 split) stays the evidence; (ii) the step, with the retry guarded by `if`, attempts and interval as named env knobs with a cited source for the wait, and a Step 3 assertion pinning it.

Its replacement step has a `set -e` bug and magic numbers, and the finding cannot be settled without deciding what to do about .github/workflows/static.yml, which deploys the repo root to the same Pages site.
